❤️🚂 RED DAY CELEBRATION – LEARNING THROUGH COLOUR & PLAY! ❤️

At Good Shepherd Pre School & Daycare, Kempapura, Hebbal, our little learners celebrated Red Day with lots of colour, creativity and joyful learning! ❤️✨

Our children explored the colour red through a fun-filled Red Train 🚂, Red Parachute 🪂 cut-outs and exciting role play.

🌟 Why do we celebrate Red Day?

Red Day is more than just wearing a colour—it helps children learn through sight, touch, movement and imagination.

❤️ Colour Recognition: Children identify and recognise the colour red in their surroundings.

🧠 Cognitive Development: Matching and identifying red objects strengthens observation and classification skills.

🎭 Role Play: Encourages imagination, creativity, communication and confidence.

🤝 Social Skills: Participating together teaches children cooperation, sharing and taking turns.

✂️ Creative Learning: Colourful cut-outs and hands-on activities strengthen fine motor skills and encourage self-expression.

🚂 Learning Through Play: The Red Train and Red Parachute transformed learning into an exciting, memorable experience!

At Good Shepherd, we believe that when children learn with joy, every colour becomes a beautiful learning adventure! 🌈❤️

✨ Little hands, big imagination, joyful learning! ✨

🏐✨ CATCH, THROW & TAKE TURNS! ✨🏐

Learning through play is always more fun at Good Shepherd Pre School & Day Care, Kempapura Hebbal! 💛

Our little ones enjoyed a fun Catch & Throw Ball Activity, taking turns to catch and throw the ball with their friends. 🥰👏

This simple yet engaging activity helps children develop:

🎯 Hand-Eye Coordination – Tracking the ball and catching it strengthens coordination.
💪 Gross Motor Skills – Throwing, catching and moving the body builds strength and control.
🧠 Focus & Concentration – Children learn to watch carefully and respond at the right moment.
🤝 Turn-Taking & Sharing – Waiting for their turn teaches patience and respect for others.
😊 Social Skills – Playing together encourages cooperation, communication and teamwork.
🌟 Confidence – Successfully catching or throwing the ball gives children a wonderful sense of achievement!

At Good Shepherd, every game is an opportunity to move, learn, interact and grow! 🌱💕

Little hands, active bodies, happy hearts! 🥰🏐

🧸✨ LEARNING THROUGH PLAY! ✨🧸

Little Feet, Big Skills! 👣🌈

At Good Shepherd Pre School & Day Care, Kempapura Hebbal, our little ones enjoyed a fun and exciting Stuff Toy Leg Pick-Up Activity! 🧸💕

In this activity, the teachers held a rod securely at both ends while the children held onto it and carefully tried to pick up the soft toys from the floor using their legs and feet. 👣🧸

This playful activity helps children develop:

🌟 Gross Motor Skills – strengthens leg and body movements
⚖️ Balance & Coordination – encourages children to control their body while reaching for the toy
🧠 Body Awareness – helps children understand how different parts of their body move
👀 Hand-Eye & Foot-Eye Coordination – encourages coordinated movement and focus
💪 Core & Leg Strength – promotes controlled movement and stability
🎯 Concentration & Focus – children carefully plan their movements to grab the toy
😊 Confidence & Independence – every successful attempt brings a sense of achievement!

Most importantly, children are learning, moving, experimenting and having fun! 💕🌈

At Good Shepherd, we believe that every playful moment is an opportunity to learn and grow. 🌱✨

🧸👣 Play • Move • Explore • Learn 👣🧸

🌈🔤 LITTLE HANDS, BIG DISCOVERIES! 🔢✨

🌾 BRUSH, DISCOVER & CIRCLE – ALPHABET AND NUMBER HUNT! 🔍

Learning becomes an adventure at Good Shepherd Pre School & Day Care, Kempapura Hebbal! ❤️

Our little explorers enjoyed an exciting sensory learning activity where alphabets and numbers were hidden beneath a tray of rice! 🌾

Armed with little brushes and lots of curiosity, our tiny learners gently brushed away the rice to uncover hidden treasures. Once they discovered an alphabet or number, they identified it and circled the matching character on their laminated activity sheets. 🔤🔢🖍️

🎯 Learning Outcomes:

🌟 Sensory Exploration: Stimulates tactile senses through hands-on learning.

🌟 Letter & Number Recognition: Strengthens identification and recognition skills.

🌟 Fine Motor Development: Improves finger control, hand-eye coordination and pre-writing skills.

🌟 Visual Discrimination: Encourages children to identify and match alphabets and numbers.

🌟 Concentration & Patience: Develops focus, observation and problem-solving abilities.

🌟 Learning Through Play: Builds confidence and makes early literacy and numeracy enjoyable.

💖 At Good Shepherd, we believe little hands learn best when they explore, discover and experience!

Every brush reveals a new discovery, and every discovery brings a smile! 🥰

✈️🌈 LITTLE PILOTS, BIG DREAMS! 👨‍✈️👩‍✈️

At Good Shepherd Pre School & Day Care, even a simple toy aeroplane can take our little learners on a wonderful journey of imagination, discovery and learning! 🧒👧✨

As our children played with toy aeroplanes, they explored the exciting world of air travel while creating their own stories and adventures. From pretending to be pilots and passengers to making their planes “take off” and “land,” every moment became an opportunity to learn through play. 🛫🧳

🌟 Why is aeroplane play significant?

✈️ Imagination & creativity – Children create their own journeys and stories.
🧠 Cognitive development – They explore concepts such as movement, direction, speed and distance.
🗣️ Language development – Role play encourages children to communicate, describe and express ideas.
🤝 Social skills – Sharing aeroplanes and playing different roles encourages cooperation and turn-taking.
🎭 Pretend play – Children experience real-life situations through imaginative role play.
🌍 World awareness – They begin to understand different modes of transportation and the wider world around them.
💪 Confidence & independence – Taking on roles such as pilot, passenger or airport staff helps children express themselves confidently.

At Good Shepherd, we believe that every toy can become a learning tool and every play experience can open the door to a new discovery. ❤️

Today, they are flying toy aeroplanes…
Tomorrow, they may be flying towards their dreams! ✨✈️☁️

Learning through Play • Exploring through Imagination • Growing with Confidence 🌱💫

✈️🌍 AT THE AIRPORT – BOARDING MY FLIGHT! 🧳🎫

Learning took flight at Good Shepherd Pre School & Day Care, Kempapura Hebbal! ✨

Our little travellers enjoyed an exciting Airport Role-Play Activity, where they experienced the different steps involved in air travel — arriving with their luggage, checking in, receiving their boarding passes, going through security, waiting at the boarding gate, and finally boarding their flight! ✈️👩‍✈️👨‍✈️

🌟 Why is this activity important?

Through this fun-filled dramatic play experience, children developed:
✈️ Real-world awareness – understanding how an airport works
🎫 Communication skills – interacting during check-in and boarding
🧳 Independence & confidence – managing their belongings and following instructions
👫 Social skills – waiting for their turn and cooperating with friends
🧠 Sequencing skills – learning the different stages of an airport journey
🎭 Imagination & creativity – taking on the roles of passengers, pilots, cabin crew and airport staff
🌍 Knowledge about transportation – connecting classroom learning with real-life experiences

At Good Shepherd, we believe children learn best when they can see, experience, participate and explore. ❤️

Our classroom transformed into a little airport, and our young passengers were ready for take-off! 🛫☁️

Learning through play • Exploring through experience • Growing with confidence 🌈

🌟 Instagram Content | Pass the Hi-Five 🤚

Little hands, big learning! 💕

Today at Good Shepherd Pre School & Daycare, our children enjoyed a fun movement game called “Pass the Hi-Five!” 🤚✨

One child squats while the two children beside them give each other a high-five. Then the next child takes their turn, and the activity continues around the circle. 🔄👧🧒

This simple game is much more than play—it helps children develop:

🤝 Social Skills – encourages interaction and connection with friends
🔄 Turn-Taking – teaches patience and waiting for their turn
💪 Gross Motor Skills – strengthens balance, coordination and body control
🧠 Body Awareness – helps children understand movement and positioning
❤️ Teamwork & Cooperation – children learn to participate together
😊 Confidence & Joy – makes physical activity fun and engaging

Because at Good Shepherd, we believe that children learn best when they PLAY, MOVE, CONNECT and HAVE FUN! 🌈

✨ Small steps, big connections, happy learners! ✨

🐠🎣 MAGNETIC FISHING FUN! 🎣🐠
Learning Through Play at Good Shepherd Preschool 💛

Our little learners had a wonderful time with our Magnetic Fishing Activity! 🥰

Children used a magnet to “fish” for colourful fish cut-outs, each with a paper clip attached. As they discovered how the magnet attracts the paper clip, they experienced the magic of science through hands-on play! ✨

🌟 What does this activity develop?

🧲 Early Science Concepts – Introduction to the concept of magnetic attraction.
🤏 Fine Motor Skills – Strengthens hand and finger muscles through controlled movement.
👀 Hand-Eye Coordination – Encourages children to carefully aim and catch the fish.
🎯 Concentration & Focus – Builds patience and attention as children try to catch their fish.
🧠 Problem-Solving Skills – Children learn through trial, observation and discovery.
😊 Confidence & Joy – Every successful catch brings a sense of achievement!

At Good Shepherd Preschool & Daycare, we believe that when children play, explore and discover, learning becomes meaningful and memorable. 🌈💫

🐠 Catch a fish… discover a concept… create a little scientist! 🧲🔬💛

👋✨ PALM PRINT PROFESSIONS – LEARN, RUB & REVEAL! ✨👋

Who knew little hands could make learning so much fun? 💕

In today’s activity, the teacher wrote the name of a profession on her palm. The children then rubbed their palms against the teacher’s palm and excitedly revealed the profession transferred onto their own hands! 🖐️✨

This simple yet engaging activity helped our little learners:

🌟 Explore different professions and understand the important roles people play in our community.
🧠 Build curiosity and memory through an element of surprise.
✋ Develop sensory awareness through hands-on learning.
🤝 Strengthen interaction and communication between teacher and child.

🎲✨ ROLL • COUNT • MATCH • SIT! ✨🎲

Learning numbers becomes so much more exciting when children can play, move and explore! 💛

In this fun number activity, children roll the dice, identify the number, count the dots, and match them with the chair showing the same number of dots. 🔢🎲🪑

🌟 Why is this activity significant?

🎯 Number Recognition – Helps children identify and recognise numbers through hands-on play.

🔢 Counting Skills – Encourages children to count dots accurately and connect numbers with quantities.

🧠 Number-Quantity Association – Builds an understanding that each number represents a specific quantity.

👀 Visual Discrimination – Children observe, compare and find the matching number of dots.

🏃‍♀️ Gross Motor Development – Moving towards the correct chair adds physical activity to the learning experience.

💡 Cognitive Skills – Rolling, thinking, counting and matching encourages problem-solving and decision-making.

🤝 Confidence & Participation – Every turn gives children an opportunity to learn independently and celebrate their success!

When children learn through play, numbers become something they can SEE, COUNT, TOUCH and EXPERIENCE! 🌈❤️
